def _token_list() -> list[str]:
    """Return the banned tokens, lowercased, from the file's EXISTING source
    (BANNED_TOKENS or _forbidden_tokens()). Must not add or remove tokens."""

def _raw_hits(src: str) -> list[str]:
    """Strict lexical scan, used for PRODUCTION files."""
    low = src.lower()
    return [t for t in _token_list() if t in low]

def _ast_identifier_hits(tree: ast.AST) -> list[tuple[int, str, str]]:
    """Semantic scan of executable identifiers. Ignores comments, docstrings
    and non-import string constants."""
    toks = _token_list()
    hits: list[tuple[int, str, str]] = []
    def check(line, ident):
        if not ident:
            return
        low = ident.lower()
        hits.extend((line, ident, t) for t in toks if t in low)
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        line = getattr(node, "lineno", 0)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
            check(line, node.id)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
            check(line, node.attr)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.arg):
            check(line, node.arg)   # catches fixture injection (monkeypatch/mocker)
        elif isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
            check(line, node.name)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.alias):
            check(line, node.name)
            check(line, node.asname)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            check(line, node.module)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.keyword):
            check(line, node.arg)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ExceptHandler):
            check(line, node.name)
        elif isinstance(node, (ast.Global, ast.Nonlocal)):
            for n in node.names:
                check(line, n)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.Call):
            f = node.func
            fname = f.id if isinstance(f, ast.Name) else (
                f.attr if isinstance(f, ast.Attribute) else None)
            if fname in ("__import__", "import_module"):
                a0 = node.args[0] if node.args else None
                if isinstance(a0, ast.Constant) and isinstance(a0.value, str):
                    check(line, a0.value)
                else:
                    hits.append((line, str(fname), "<non-literal dynamic import>"))
    return hits

**A2. Step 2: make the fixture check concrete, and scope the dynamic-import flag.**
